the toxicity and immunological responses to Co and Cr ions and wear debris depend on the dose, the cell type, the cell state and the experimental conditions.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the toxicity and immunological responses to metal ions and debris are dependent on the concentration of metal ions, the type of metal ion, and the cell type, which is consistent with previous studies.

cobalt ions and particles are toxic, and that they induce the expression of genes involved in inflammation, cell proliferation, and apoptosis, and they also alter cell function.
